howItWorks.title: One search. Every Vienna student dorm.
howItWorks.subtitle: Vienna has 70+ dorm buildings from 11 providers across 8 booking websites. Each portal has its own process, and rooms appear and vanish in hours. Dormra watches them all so you don't have to.
howItWorks.step1Desc: All providers in one place — filter by price, district, deposit and amenities.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Tell Dormra your criteria once. We check every 15 minutes, across every provider.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Email alert the moment a matching room opens up.
howItWorks.faq1a: Browsing and basic alerts will always be free. We are in private beta — pricing for advanced alerts will be announced before launch.
howItWorks.faq2a: 11 providers across Vienna: OeAD, STUWO, home4students, ÖJAB, Akademikerhilfe, WIHAST, Viennabase, The Fizz, Milestone, Youth Hostel Vienna, and Sparverein der Magistratsbeamten. We scrape 8 booking websites and add more continuously.
howItWorks.faq3q: How accurate is the availability data?
howItWorks.faq3a: We re-scrape every 15 minutes and compare each snapshot to the previous one. Rows older than 6 hours are marked as "Status unknown" so you never act on stale data.
howItWorks.faq4q: Does Dormra apply on my behalf?
howItWorks.faq4a: Not yet — today we send you straight to the provider with everything pre-filled when possible. A universal application layer is on the Phase 5 roadmap.
howItWorks.faq5q: I am not in Vienna — when will you cover my city?
howItWorks.faq5a: Graz, Salzburg, Innsbruck and Linz come right after Vienna. Berlin, Munich, Prague and Amsterdam follow.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.overviewBody: Dormra ("we", "us") operates a student-housing aggregator for Vienna and respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. We are in private beta — this page will be updated with final legal text before public launch.
privacy.collect1: Account email and authentication metadata (Supabase Auth, EU region).
privacy.collect2: Your saved search criteria and alert preferences.
privacy.collect3: Application status you choose to track in your personal kanban.
privacy.collect4: Anonymous analytics on which pages you visit, used only to improve the product.
privacy.useBody: We use your data only to deliver the service: matching new dorm availability against your saved criteria, sending you alerts by email or Telegram, and showing you your own application tracker. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for advertising.
privacy.rightsBody: You can export or delete your account and all associated data at any time from your account settings. For any privacy question, write to

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.serviceBody: Dormra aggregates publicly listed student dorm availability from third-party providers and notifies you when matching rooms become available. We are not a housing provider and do not handle bookings or payments between you and any provider.
terms.accuracyBody: We strive to keep listings current by re-scraping every 15 minutes, but we cannot guarantee a room will still be available at the exact moment you contact the provider. Availability can change within minutes — always confirm directly with the provider before relying on a listing.
